title: Learning from Another Angle: Rotation-Based Test-Time Training for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28972v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision-language tasks but often remain vulnerable to distribution shifts due to their fixed parameters during inference. While Test-Time Training (TTT) offers a pathway for dynamic adaptation, existing approaches suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to multiple sampling and the risk of error reinforcement from biased self-generated supervision. In light of this view, we propose RoTTT (Rotation-based Test-Time Training), a simple and efficient TTT approach that enables instance-specific refinement at inference time. For each test instance, RoTTT performs a small number of gradient updates by predicting the rotation angle of the input image. The known rotation angles naturally serve as a reliable self-supervised signal, enabling lightweight and stable adaptation without requiring additional annotations. translated_title: 从另一个角度学习：面向多模态大语言模型的基于旋转的测试时训练
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉-语言任务上取得了出色的性能，但由于推理过程中参数保持固定，往往容易受到分布偏移的影响。测试时训练为动态适应提供了一条途径，然而现有方法因需要多次采样而带来高昂的计算开销，且来自有偏的自我生成监督存在误差强化的风险。鉴于此，我们提出了RoTTT（基于旋转的测试时训练），这是一种简单高效的测试时训练方法，能够在推理阶段进行针对特定样本的精细化调整。对于每个测试样本，RoTTT通过预测输入图像的旋转角度来执行少量的梯度更新。已知的旋转角度天然地构成可靠的自监督信号，从而实现轻量且稳定的适应，无需任何额外标注。我们在多个视觉-语言任务上进行了大量实验。
tldr: 提出RoTTT方法，利用预测输入图像旋转角度这一可靠自监督信号进行测试时训练，以轻量高效的方式增强多模态大语言模型应对分布偏移的能力。
en_tdlr: RoTTT enables lightweight and stable test-time training for multimodal large language models by predicting known image rotation angles as a reliable self-supervised signal, avoiding the heavy computational cost of existing approaches.
